body:
Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed) :: Cryomancies
The reason you were temp-banned/banned:: Fly hacking and anti kb
Why you should be unbanned from the server :: I didn't hack lol, BTW! I record every single time i'm on AVN because of shit like this, so i should definitely be able to prove  myself innocent.

Also i was banned like half an hour ago (9.23 pm, right now 10:02 pm), and i'm not 100% sure i was even on that time, so pls check if the IP's match or not. That said, i think there might have been a mistake with the ban (wrong player maybe?) because i find it hard to believe i was banned for these reasons. Also i was banned by Javipepe.

So if you need me to upload the evidence of my latest match, tell me and i'll do it. (unfortunately it's like 27 mins long)
 It's quite late right now so i'm going to have to try to settle this out tomorrow.
Pce
- Cryo aka SaltMagnet

replies.body:
Could you please explain what happened in here ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=az55a7SUwWo ) and how you got such a high blatant survivalfly violation at the same time? 



In the video, you are not lagging, you are not losing moving packets because there are no running, or even moving particles beneath your feet. You are not frozen by any staff member:



And last but not least you are not frozen / fps lagging / server lagging because rest of the server moves alright, you are shifting constantly and also, when being hit by enemy, you are "conscious" because you are blocking with your sword.

If you were not hacking (we can always make mistakes) just tell me with evidence support what part of my history is wrong or isn't real as to what happened in your screen.
